Google has confirmed that ads in AI Mode reach the UK in the fourth quarter. Existing campaigns are eligible automatically, there is no opt-out, and the results sit inside your normal totals.

In this clip Hannah and I cover what that means for a paid search lead. The job for AI is to take your last eight weeks of campaign data and search terms and give you a baseline to compare December against.

The podcast voices are AI-generated, and mine is a clone of my own voice.

Full episode and article at https://manual-focus.co.uk/blog/google-ai-mode-ads-uk-paid-search/
clips.text: So here's the question every paid lead will ask. Can I keep my campaigns out of it? No. Google's Ads help page on AI-powered experiences says existing Search, Shopping and Performance Max campaigns are eligible automatically. You can't opt out of AI Mode or AI Overviews separately from Search, and you can't target them on their own. Negative keywords and brand exclusions still limit where ads show, and those are the only levers it lists. And reporting? It's all in aggregate. Impressions, clicks, conversions and cost from these placements go into your normal campaign reports, and the queries sit in the search terms report with everything else. So you won't see an AI Mode line.
